description: How many complaints, recalls and federal defect investigations does this model have? Returns the three counts NHTSA links to a make, model and model year, as a quick screen when comparing cars. Source: NHTSA NCAP records. Counts are not adjusted for sales volume, so a popular model will show more; only models in the NCAP programme are covered. Use vehicle_recalls and vehicle_complaints for the detail. (cost: 1 credit)

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda

model.description: string, required, US model name, e.g. accord

name: vehicle_problem_counts
